notes: Method: pixel analysis of the supplied page PNGs (two pixels per point; PDF coordinates are pixel/2, y downward from the page top). Ink threshold gray<150 with connected specks of 3 px or fewer removed. Each column was located from the horizontal ink projection; the number/classification field (a narrow block of two short text lines) was located as the right-hand or left-hand narrow block of the column, and each field block (number line plus classification line, merged) counted as one numbered row. The numbered row centre is the vertical middle of the glyph ink in the glyph window beside that field block, excluding a detached dashed underline and including small marks above the first sign; it is the glyph line's middle, not the field's middle (the field block sits about 2.25 pt lower than the glyph line's middle). Unnumbered lines were found as glyph ink in a column's glyph window that belongs to no field block; each was checked on a zoomed crop, its parent number was read from the field of the numbered line directly above it, and it was cross-checked against the regular 19.8 pt (39.5 px) slot grid: every column has up to 36 slots, and every jump of two pitches between consecutive numbered lines corresponds to exactly one continuation line. Every page was checked against its image: overlays of the detected centres were viewed for pages 35, 62, 77, 127, 129, 130 and 175 and on contact sheets for 46, 47, 58, 108, 122, 138, 163, 171 and 172, and the original images were viewed for pages 32, 35, 62, 80, 92, 98, 129, 130, 134, 172 and 175. Layouts: pages 32-77, 134, 138, 163, 171, 172 and 175 have the field at the right of right-aligned glyph lines; pages 80, 92, 98, 108, 122, 127, 129 and 130 have the field at the left of left-aligned glyph lines. x_extent_pdf spans the column's ink including its field and any continuation lines; x_extent_numbered_lines_only_pdf is given where continuation lines widen the column. Isolated marks outside the columns (page-edge scan marks, specks) were ignored. No glyph contents were read. The only digits read were the parent numbers of the seven continuation lines (1400, 2690, 2725, 2352, 3123, 2835, 2768). Exposure: I did not open predictions.json, frame.json, prediction-freeze.json, count-page-detections.json, full-summary.json, any file outside BLIND other than the prompt file, any other reader's folder, the PDF text layer, or anything under data/raw other than my scratch folder; I saw no prediction or other reading. I created BLIND/reader-a/ with mkdir only to write this file. started_utc is the first clock reading in the session (a few minutes after the prompt was read).
